recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-3520 unless a future terminology-package reconciliation identifies a separate THO issue outside this checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-3520 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction for DSTU1. It reported that V3 value sets ObservationMethod and Confidentiality appeared twice in the old v3-codesystems terminology input, with the second occurrence composing the code system from the first occurrence.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied under FHIR-3208. The 2014 commit d6bac5596bb992f6535f586f19d87690d5cb15aa, '{#3208}: fix confusion with v3 value sets', commented out ObservationMethod and Confidentiality in source/v3/valuesets.ini and added duplicate-name checks for generated V3 terminology. FHIR-3520's Jira comments say it was fixed under another task.
additional_context: The old source/v3/valuesets.ini input was deleted by 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 as part of removing UTG content from the core build, and the current checkout has no source/v3 directory or v3-codesystems.xml. Current core documentation describes hl7.terminology as the package for HL7-maintained code systems and value sets; the local hl7.terminology 7.1.0 package has separate CodeSystem and ValueSet artifacts for v3-Confidentiality and v3-ObservationMethod.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current core source already reflects the historical cleanup and no build-scope core file needs to be edited.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-3520 explicitly says it is similar to FHIR-3208, and the historical {#3208} commit also removed the ObservationMethod and Confidentiality duplicate entries named by FHIR-3520.
